Company Description
 Inetum is a European leader in digital services. For businesses, public sector organizations, and society as a whole, the group’s 26,000 consultants and specialists work every day to create tangible digital impact: solutions that contribute to performance, innovation, and the common good.
With a presence in 19 countries, working closely with local communities, and alongside its major software developer partners, Inetum supports organizations in their digital transformation challenges with proximity, flexibility, and responsibility. Driven by its purpose, Inetum champions a vision of technology that is useful and well-managed, capable of unlocking the full potential of organizations and society: “Let’s make tech right.”
In 2025, the group generated revenue of 2.2 billion euros.
More information at: www.inetum.com

 Job Description
You will be responsible for testing applications and IT systems to ensure their quality, reliability, and compliance with business requirements.
 Responsibilities
Define various testing strategies, including manual and API testing
Create and execute test plans, test cases, and test scripts
Maintain test data sets
Perform functional and technical testing to identify defects and anomalies and ensure the quality of applications and systems
Set up and execute regression testing
Ensure defect reporting and follow-up
Ensure the quality of user stories and acceptance criteria
Collaborate with development and production teams to identify and resolve issues
Contribute to the preparation of test reports and testing documentation
Ensure compliance with testing standards and procedures
Participate in Agile ceremonies and contribute to user story elaboration
Work closely with other testing team members to share knowledge and best practices
 Qualifications
Minimum of 4 years of experience in software testing
Knowledge of Agile testing methodologies
Experience with testing tools such as Octane, Jira, and Postman/Bruno
Knowledge of programming languages such as Java
Knowledge of testing standards and methodologies (ISTQB etc.)
Ability to work effectively within a team and communicate clearly and efficiently
 Skills
Functional and technical testing
Knowledge of testing tools and programming/scripting languages
Fluent French
Functional knowledge of the consumer credits domain is a plus
